title: Compare alternatives
unsupported: This target has not declared comparison support. Upgrade the target to continue.
empty: No alternatives are linked. Add independent worktree tasks for this requirement.
unknownResult: Result unknown: no readable task description is available.
unknownChecks: Checks unknown: no readable native execution receipts.
partialEvidence: Check coverage is limited. Unlisted checks remain unverified.
checkDetails: Inspect check scope and original output
unknownUsage: Usage unknown: no readable provider usage records.
usage: Recorded input {{input}} / output {{output}} tokens ({{samples}} of {{messages}} visible replies have usage).
unknownCost: Cost unknown: no attributable cost receipt and pricing basis.
changes: Inspect actual changes and artifact identities
head: Current HEAD: {{commit}}
diffScope: The diff covers tracked files from the common baseline. Untracked files appear only in status; ignored files are excluded. Workspaces may still be receiving writes.
unknownChanges: Changes unknown: worktree identity or content could not be verified.
selectionScope: Selection only binds the source for subsequent delivery. Other alternatives, workspaces and uncommitted content are retained. Selection does not merge code or start another model task.
label: Alternative name
createScope: Create an independent worktree for this requirement and start one normal task using the model and budget shown above. If the outcome is unknown, inspect existing tasks and worktrees before creating another.

errors.unsupported: This target does not support comparisons. Upgrade the target.
errors.scope_changed: The target or owner task changed. Reopen comparison from the current task.
errors.invalid_response: Comparison identity or format does not match. Refresh and inspect the records.
errors.task_mismatch: The task does not match the target worktree. Choose the correct independent task.
errors.creation_unavailable: Task creation is unavailable. Link an existing task.
errors.request_failed: The operation is unconfirmed. Refresh and inspect existing records. Worktrees and tasks are retained.

unavailable.branch_changed: The current branch changed and no longer matches this alternative.
unavailable.selection_changed: The selected content changed. Review and select the alternative again.
unavailable.git_unavailable: Actual Git identity or changes are unavailable.
unavailable.transcript_unavailable: Task history is unavailable. Results and usage are unknown.

creationSummary: Model: {{model}} · Independent task token budget: unset. Current model options and permission choices are retained.

reviewDialog.title: Results, checks and feedback
reviewDialog.empty: No ended responses are available to review.
reviewDialog.unavailable: The selected response is outside the loaded history. Load earlier responses or select another response.
reviewDialog.loadFailed: History could not be loaded. Try again.
reviewDialog.noEvidence: This response has no recorded artifacts or executions to review.
